claim_en: THE SPLIT. Who values and who is valued, two arms with the widths swapped; the articulate minor; do-not-delay imported.
STANDING. What can stand is valued; worth and valuation classes cross; boundary years count below, a month and a day past; Onkelos's sela.
FOUR CLOCKS. Means by the vower, years and valuation by the valued, at the valuation's time; Onkelos names the vower.
LIMBS. A leg's holiness disputed; only individuals substitute; the tithe went out to teach.
SUBSTITUTION. Not transitive; woman and heir; one for a hundred; kind bounds; the owner's house overruling the argument; holy even blemished, even in error.
DISQUALIFIED. Blemished consecrated beasts redeemed; the dead by hour-equality; birds, wood, frankincense, vessels not.
THE LADDER. No estimate; each retracting bidder liable down to the next standing bid.
THE FIFTH. Owner adds, others do not; woman and heir count as owners.

source: Sifra, Bechukotai, Section 4 8-9 + Chapter 10 1-2 + Onkelos Lev 27:14-15
claim_en: UPKEEP. The default destination; the owner's precedence with the fifth's ceiling; title on payment.
THE DECREE. Fifty per homer of seed regardless of quality, self-labeled a king's decree; Onkelos converts homer to kor.
FORTY-NINE. The per-year rate derived; crevices and rocks excluded; the Jubilee year itself.
THE FLOORS. Two before, one after; months the sanctuary's option; lump sum; the deduction runs against the sanctuary too.
REDEEM. Any field size; title on payment.
SON IN. The son inherits the father's standing, the brother does not; a purchase from the treasurer stands.
THE ABANDONED FIELD. Three arms on the priests' entry; the redeeming priest holds nothing alone.
THE PURCHASED FIELD. Holding by the father's death; worth versus the decree rate disputed; paid that day.
THE SELA. Returns to the seller; never under a sela; twenty gerah; Onkelos's twenty ma'in at its source.
THE FIRSTBORN. Consecrated from the womb only; value-consecration yes, altar no; holiness not re-assigned; the substitute not offered.
ASSESSED. Any movable, priced in money; it and its fifth are five.
DEVOTION. Never all; Canaanite slaves; unspecified to upkeep (disputed); priests and Levites split by land and movables.
THE CONDEMNED. No valuation after sentence; valued-not-vowed against full capacity.
TITHE. Edible seeds and fruits by the partitive; redemption's persons and exclusions; five.

source: Sifra, Bechukotai, Chapter 12 11-13 + Chapter 13 1-3 + Onkelos Lev 27:32
claim_en: THE ERROR RULE. Kinds; two tithes a year; the torn cannot pass; misnamed neighbors sanctified, the twelfth not.
LASHES. No picking; lashes for substituting; firstborn sold, tithe neither; a standing command.
THE CLOSE. The canon shut against prophetic innovation; all from Sinai.
